items.n_e6280572d8: Feature: Support QUIC on all platforms
items.n_1832eb06c1: Feature: Split DNS — DNS queries now follow your split tunneling rules, so bypassed apps and sites resolve outside the tunnel
items.n_bd42460eac: Feature: Unrouted IP protection — choose to block or bypass destinations the server cannot route, so traffic never leaks silently
items.n_a88354ede7: Feature: Split tunneling master switch — one tap keeps all traffic inside the VPN and blocks what the server cannot carry
items.n_d28209ee1c: Feature: IPv6 option to block or bypass IPv6 when the server does not support it
items.n_9c5f3b9e01: Feature: Built-in report viewer — view and share diagnostic reports right inside the app
items.n_938d0b9740: Improve: Sign out, delete account and remove premium code now show progress while they work
items.n_579cfe079d: Improve: Shorter first-run privacy summary, now translated into every supported language
items.n_a748595e46: Improve: Initialization speed when using split tunneling by country
items.n_ab1ff88a0f: Fix: Very slow download speed on iOS
items.n_6bfa308ff4: Fix: Deleting your account on one device left it visible, and still signed in, on your other devices
items.n_9548de2be6: Fix: Signing out could take away an access code that was still paid for
items.n_581f5f02f0: Fix: Premium features stayed unlocked locally after a subscription had expired
items.n_c4deeaf54f: Fix: Windows and Linux shipped without the default server, leaving the server list empty on first run
items.n_4174396f26: Fix: A stray UDP packet could permanently stop unrelated UDP flows sharing the same server port
items.n_0682e5bced: Fix: UDP flows sending without replies for over a minute could no longer receive responses
items.n_0b082c2950: Update: Removed the legacy UDP proxy and the server's UseUdpProxy2 option; the shared UDP proxy is now always used and behaves as a port-restricted NAT
items.n_54981f93bc: Update: Changing split-country, split-ip and split-domain filters no longer needs a reconnect
